notes: Used airframes arrive with fewer items: a 10-year-old aircraft has about five open items instead of ten, and it never arrives with a pressurisation, bleed, gear or brake fault already failed.
Part condition follows the aircraft's age, and older used airframes are brought to it once when they load; the wear you have flown stays.
Reseeding an airframe now gives the same livery a different set of worn parts and failures.
The CIDS units follow the variant, so the A319 no longer lists units it does not have.
